searchText: Just in time for EIP-1559 launch: we just added a little web front-end to the open-source cadCAD/radCAD model Ethereum Economic Model shared here earlier. It's quite fun, hope some here will find it useful. We are always super grateful for feedback and suggestions (contact@cadlabs.org). https://twitter.com/CADLabs_org/status/1423254314370441216?s=20 Hey guys, having issues with @walletconnect/truffle-provider not sending the transcation after being connected? I also having issues with truffle-ledger-provider Looking for a good way to use my ledger to deploy a contract you'd probably be best served reaching out to truffle or walletconnect
